models.note: GPT-6 Astra rejects reasoning effort `none` and offers the Ultrafast tier. The Bedrock Mantle `openai.` form is deliberately not matched here, so Mantle ids fall through to the generic gpt-5.6+ record.
GPT-6.1 Sol keeps `none` but offers the Ultrafast tier.
GPT-5.5 Pro has the restricted medium/high/xhigh effort ladder and no Fast tier. Flex is cross-checked against pricing mirrors and the exclusion list rather than a directly read official flex tab.
GPT-5.5 supports none through xhigh, but not minimal or max. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-5.4 Pro has the restricted medium/high/xhigh effort ladder and no Fast tier. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-5.4 mini supports none through xhigh. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-5.4 nano supports none through xhigh and has no Fast tier. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-5.4 supports none through xhigh. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched; Pro, mini, and nano have their own records.
GPT-5.3 Codex supports low through xhigh without a none effort. Its upstream default effort and unconfirmed Flex/Fast tiers are deliberately not materialized.
GPT-5.2 Pro has the restricted medium/high/xhigh effort ladder and no Flex/Fast tiers. Its upstream default effort is deliberately not materialized.
GPT-5.2 supports none through xhigh. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched; Pro has its own record.
GPT-5.1 supports none but not minimal or xhigh. The canonical id and dated snapshots do not cover the shut-down Codex variants.
GPT-5 Pro accepts only the high reasoning effort and has no Flex/Fast tiers.
GPT-5 mini starts at minimal and does not support none or xhigh. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-5 nano starts at minimal and does not support none or xhigh. It has no Fast tier.
GPT-5 starts at minimal and does not support none or xhigh. Pro, mini, nano, Codex, and newer versions do not match this record.
o3 supports the low/medium/high effort ladder. The canonical id and dated snapshots do not cover o3-pro, o3-mini, or deep-research variants.
o3-pro has no Flex/Fast tiers. Reasoning effort is deliberately undeclared because the upstream parameter contract is not documented.
GPT-4.1 mini is non-reasoning and supports Fast but not Flex. Only the canonical id and dated snapshots are matched.
GPT-4.1 is non-reasoning and supports Fast but not Flex. The canonical id and dated snapshots do not cover nano.
GPT-4o mini is non-reasoning and supports Fast but not Flex. Audio and realtime variants do not match.
GPT-4o is non-reasoning. Fast is declared only for the alias and the still-available 2024-08-06 and 2024-11-20 snapshots; the shut-down 2024-05-13 snapshot and audio/realtime variants do not match.
chat-latest is non-reasoning and has no Flex/Fast tiers.

GPT-5.6 and later expose the extended effort ladder, the pro reasoning mode, and the OpenAI service_tier ladder (Ultrafast stays on the 6.x records above). The optional `openai.` prefix covers Bedrock Mantle ids.
